publicFacts.objective: Persist the selected Female or Male intro example immediately and restore it on relaunch.
relevantDecisions: Default invalid or absent values to Female.
Store only a device-local UI preference.
acceptanceCriteria: Web persists the choice immediately and restores it after remount.
Android normalizes invalid values and retains valid choices.

publicFacts.objective: Reveal or hide only the selected Live Round topic card while keeping the other card still.
relevantDecisions: Selected-card reveal and hide use a targeted flip motion.
The selected motion duration is distinct from the existing round-start deal.
acceptanceCriteria: The app targets a topic flip to the selected difficulty.
The stylesheet supplies both reveal and hide flip classes.
The standalone verifier recognizes the topic-flip motion.
riskTriggers: Recovered history retains this as part of the nearest audience-flow commit rather than a dedicated topic-flip branch.

publicFacts.objective: Make visible Back controls return to the immediate previous app screen without using raw browser history.
relevantDecisions: Normalized hash routes are retained in a bounded in-memory stack.
Direct routes fall back safely; Host Remote phase reversal remains Previous Step.
Round View is not labeled Back.
acceptanceCriteria: The app records normalized route transitions and resolves a previous-route fallback.
Host Remote keeps Previous Step and the tool panel says Round View.
The standalone verifier covers the controlled route-stack contract.
riskTriggers: Recovered history retains the change in the nearest hardening commit rather than a dedicated MEJA-092 branch.

publicFacts.objective: Make Google-plus-QR first-time pairing recover the exact session and keep a second controller view-only.
relevantDecisions: QR routes carry an exact session id.
Realtime presence selects one controller and the second remote is view-only.
Remote controls wait until the exact session is loaded.
acceptanceCriteria: Core helpers generate and parse exact remote-session routes.
The app gates controls on exact-session loading and uses presence-based controller access.
The focused session-reliability test records the contract.
riskTriggers: Physical paired-device and provider-backed release checks remain out of scope for this archive-only fixture.

publicFacts.objective: Align the first intro action across Web, Android, and iOS and correct the bounded iOS presentation.
relevantDecisions: Use exactly See the Real You.
Use a bold Fira Sans iOS headline.
Keep iOS portrait previews stacked and landscape previews Mirror-left and Actual-right within preview bounds.
acceptanceCriteria: All three source trees contain the exact CTA.
iOS records the Fira Sans and preview-bounds contracts in focused tests.

publicFacts.objective: Make the Android live camera upright and side-by-side when the device is in landscape.
relevantDecisions: Only the live camera permits user-controlled orientation.
Portrait is Mirror above Actual; landscape is Mirror-left and Actual-right.
Display rotation updates CameraX targets without resetting the camera session.
acceptanceCriteria: Orientation chooses stacked or side-by-side layout.
Physical left/right offsets and target rotations have focused coverage.

publicFacts.objective: Show a local Actual-view reassurance before the camera while preserving recovery and privacy behavior.
relevantDecisions: The route is Intro, permission when needed, reassurance, then Camera.
Only a checked Continue persists reminder suppression.
No reminder, preference, or copy analytics is added.
acceptanceCriteria: Web renders the approved reassurance and Continue action.
Android routes a granted first entry through ActualReassurance and covers the route.

publicFacts.objective: Let Home scroll with a real wheel gesture when content exceeds the viewport.
relevantDecisions: The browser root is the scrolling element, not body alone.
The responsive contract exercises a real wheel gesture.
acceptanceCriteria: Home CSS enables root vertical scrolling.
Responsive verification checks root overflow and wheel scrolling.

publicFacts.objective: Show a dismissible, styled warning when cloud sync fails without blocking local play.
relevantDecisions: The warning uses an alert banner with a dismiss action.
The warning styling is scoped as MEJA-100 sync-warning presentation.
acceptanceCriteria: The app renders a sync-warning alert from syncError.
The banner can be dismissed.
The stylesheet contains the warning-banner presentation.

publicFacts.objective: Use one native shutter for Actual photos and silent Actual clips.
relevantDecisions: Release before 250ms captures one photo.
At or over 250ms starts one clip; release finalizes it without a photo.
Clips cap at 30 seconds and clean up on cancellation, interruption, backgrounding, and error.
acceptanceCriteria: Android models the unified gesture and visual states with focused threshold coverage.
iOS models the long-press policy, deferred stop policy, and 30-second cap.

publicFacts.objective: Prevent the native iOS camera from aborting when Start camera opens the preview.
relevantDecisions: Query mirroring capability only for an active connection with a video input port.
Keep Actual/Mirror switching and capture behavior intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Camera mirroring goes through an active-video connection policy.
Focused tests cover inactive, non-video, and active-video policy paths.

publicFacts.objective: Prevent unauthenticated or excessive AI use and scope remote deletions to the signed-in user.
relevantDecisions: The Edge Function authenticates before AI work and applies per-action limits.
Rate-limit records use RLS-aware migration support.
Frontend remote deletion is limited to the signed-in account.
acceptanceCriteria: The archived Edge Function has an authentication gate before rate limiting and OpenAI work.
The archived Edge Function defines the 30/15/30 per-action limits and rate-limit storage.
The archived frontend scopes remote deletes by user id.
The archived hardening script checks source files without provider calls.
riskTriggers: This proof is credential-free and static; it does not execute an Edge Function or contact Supabase or OpenAI.
